items.title: Novo Hamburgo (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #CPC 1
items.en_title: Novo Hamburgo (RS) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #CPC 1
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Novo Hamburgo (RS) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 3,207,960; proposals close Nov 26, 10:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
